claims.text: SGLang v0.5.9 was published on 2026-02-24 and added support for model families including Kimi-K2.5, GLM-5, Qwen3.5, MiniMax M2.5, and multiple multimodal/diffusion models.
The release added an Anthropic-compatible API endpoint and substantial inference, MoE, multimodal, and diffusion runtime changes.
Reported improvements such as roughly 78% lower TTFT for overlapped LoRA loading and 3–5x DeepSeek V3.2 NSA acceleration on Blackwell are project claims, not independent measurements.

limitations.text: Performance figures come from project release notes and are not independently reproduced.
Support entries establish implementation availability, not equivalent quality or benchmark validation across model families.
